note: Curated 2026-10-26 (Derek: 'Ruusbroec also', alongside the Evelyn Underhill shelf). Jan van Ruusbroec (1293-1381): editions and translations of his works printed before 1931 not already held. Already held: De ornatu 1512 (x2), Surius Opera 1552 (x2), Opera omnia 1609, Opera 1692, German 1701, T'Cieraet 1624, Die Zierde 1922 (Mainz), Adornment 1916 (Underhill ed., imported today), studies by Maeterlinck 1894, Scully 1910, Underhill 1914. Skipped: Hello's Rusbrock 1869 Google scan (no jp2; the 1926 Perrin printing is imported instead), Spiritual Espousals (Colledge 1952, in copyright), Rubruck/Mandeville false hits (William of Rubruck).
